policies.description: Additional D-Bus policy entries for controlling access to the mkhomedir service. Each entry defines permissions for a specific user or group.

description.description: Human-readable description of this policy (used as XML comment).

user.description: System username to whom this policy applies (e.g., 'root', 'nobody').

group.description: System group name to whom this policy applies (e.g., 'wheel', 'admin').

allow_own.description: Service name the user/group may own (e.g., 'com.redhat.oddjob.mkhomedir').

allow_send.description: Service name the user/group may send messages to (e.g., 'com.redhat.oddjob.mkhomedir').

deny_send.description: Service name the user/group must be denied from sending to.

receive_sender.description: Sender name the user/group is allowed to receive messages from.
